article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Logan Duncomb's 24 points helped Winthrop defeat South Carolina Upstate 68-64 on Thursday. Duncomb had 16 rebounds for the Eagles (20-8, 12-1 Big South Conference). Kody Clouet scored 17 points and added nine rebounds. It was the 12th straight victory for the Eagles. Carmelo Adkins led the Spartans (11-17, 3-10) in scoring, finishing with 21 points and two steals. Karmani Gregory added 18 points and two steals for South Carolina Upstate. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
